entities.summary: Pitika Ntuli is a South African sculptor, poet, writer, and academic. His work explores African spirituality, identity, and the legacy of colonialism through a multidisciplinary practice that blends art, language, and activism. Ntuli spent over three decades in political exile during apartheid, living in Eswatini and the United Kingdom before returning to South Africa in the early 1990s.
